THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
4 · Goblin trail and traps
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

The goblin trail narrows under the trees. Broken twigs and churned earth show several small creatures passed this way, with heavier marks among them. The road disappears behind you.

Each disturbed patch offers a place to slow down and look, while the thicker growth limits what you can see ahead. You can keep the heavier marks in view, check the ground before committing your weight, or pause to decide how closely you want to follow.

Ask the players

“Who leads? Are you moving quickly or watching for traps?”

Ask what happens to the wagon and supplies while the party pursues the trail.

Choices

If the party chooses a different route, keep their rescue lead available through tracks, captives, or Phandalin.
